title: cerastium mutabile var. grandiflorum
intro: Cerastium mutabile var. grandiflorum, commonly known as the 'Alpine Forget-Me-Not', is a flowering plant in the pink family (Caryophyllaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Cerastium mutabile var. grandiflorum include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cognitive function due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues, and its potential as an adaptogenic agent to promote stress relief and balance the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium mutabile var. grandiflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
